parent: Exact f696 allocation plus b472 action/risk/recovery remains the later economic parent. Only old original39 Qlib inputs and their saved mature H5 price labels are read here.
hypothesis: When SOXX has strong prior60-session trend but SOXL has lagged the observed 3x SOXX 20-session path, SOXX may be the preferable bridge asset over both cash and SOXL. A frozen positive trend-times-negative-relative-path interaction should rank the next-H5 minimum of SOXX-over-cash and SOXX-over-SOXL advantages in the positive direction.
fixed_factor: On each predecision signal date, zT=(soxx_ret60 - 2011-2020 training median)/2011-2020 training SD and zD=(levered_decay_20 - 2011-2020 training median)/2011-2020 training SD. Factor=max(zT,0)*max(-zD,0). These are two existing original39 inputs; this is a new joint receiver/interaction, not a new raw source.
fixed_label: min(-cash_advantage_H5,-SOXL_relative_H5) from the saved matched Qlib DatasetH. Positive means SOXX beats both cash and SOXL over the next five open-to-open price intervals before fees. Require both labels mature; no account claim.
distinctness: Old original39 dual cash/relative Ridge heads failed separately, and broad-rebound cash interaction failed. This fixed interaction targets the joint SOXX bridge-asset margin motivated by the full f696 cash plus selection interval attribution. It does not reopen either old loss or relabel an old score as alpha.

evaluation.rank_calendar: all 503 Qlib signal dates from2021-01-01 through2022-12-30, keeping immature/missing rows in bootstrap calendar
evaluation.gate: Full Spearman positive, both2021 and2022 Spearman positive, and corrected63-session stationary-block lower bound positive on full503-day calendar

stop: Any source/timing/maturity/support gate or necessary rank gate failure closes this exact two-input interaction/joint-margin receiver before a fitted model or account. No formula sign, zero cutoff, horizon or year rescue on reused history.
scientific_boundary: A necessary rank pass would only permit a separately frozen incremental original39 information test and then an exact f696 own-state 0bp Tiered account if accepted. This gross H5 price margin does not include fees, risk feedback, full-minute drawdown, CVaR, corrected benchmark test, 2/5bp or independent forward evidence.
